hello.source: read-only journal follow; no reboot or RF controls

disconnect.assessment: Native evidence independently confirms peer EOF, journal termination/reaping, both journal PIDs absent and native job/scratch removal. The original harness then rejected its less-than-eight-second overall orchestration condition. This condition includes native carrier retirement after observer cleanup and is not a measured collector teardown deadline. Preserve the failed host outcome; do not relabel it green. No second radio test was run to replace it.

shutdown_ordering.additional_inherited_listener_holder: AetherHealth PID1278 shares the listener/cgroup; socket ownership alone is not unique firmware-process attribution. systemctl MainPID confirms1143.
shutdown_ordering.meaning: Current AetherPD boot/socket/shim/session After/Before lists do not order against smartsdr.service. Concurrent stops are possible. This does not establish the cause of the failed whole-radio reboot or authorize weakening guardian lifetime policy.
shutdown_ordering.source: Live systemctl show snapshot and tools/pd-waveform/boot/units.py; no proprietary executable inspection.

bounds.journal_scope: current boot, PID1/kernel/aetherpd and observed firmware units
bounds.disk: host-only fsync after each accepted record; no radio persistent trace file

limits: No software reboot or shutdown trace was performed in these tests. Failed prior reboot remains unqualified; prior boot journal was unavailable after hard power removal.

Read-only journal follower and initial unit snapshot cannot diagnose a kernel/firmware lockup with no emitted record. A shutdown can kill the temporary collector/container or network before its bounded deadline. Host EOF without a complete terminal record is partial evidence, never a successful reboot receipt.

Live normal capture contained28 selected journal records and11 heartbeats in12.025s; no selected drops/oversize. History includes diagnostic-waveform upload activity; no claim of a quiet baseline or absence of all unrelated work.

This is a development lab observer delivered through the existing broad privileged diagnostics transport. It is not installed or shipped. The unencrypted LAN stream, source address/nonce check and pattern-based redaction are not a production authentication or comprehensive secrecy guarantee. Receiver tokens/state and desktop credentials were excluded from the archive.
No service definitions, firmware defaults, reboot guards, scheduling, IQ routing or installed payload were changed. Native observer terminated/reaped only its own journal follower.
Collector protocol host check passed; initial restricted-sandbox socket-option denial is preserved. The original disconnect host timing receipt remains failed, with separate native cleanup evidence.
No RF, actual6300, final graph active/keyed shutdown, whole-volume disk, remote-account/platform, stockAPD or release qualification is implied. User-deferred5W SWR/preamble work remains deferred.
next_step: Design a bounded observable service-stop sequence while firmware/API remain available, preserving guardians until receive recovery. Correlate each unit/process transition before considering another software reboot; a future reboot must have the operator aware of possible physical power recovery and cannot be automatically retried.
